12	const defaultProfilesDir = "scripts/benchmark/profiles"
13	
14	func cmdProfiles(args []string) int {
15		if len(args) == 0 {
16			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Usage: %s profiles <subcommand>\n\nSubcommands:\n  list   List profiles under scripts/benchmark/profiles/\n", benchCommandName())
17			return 2
18		}
19		switch args[0] {
20		case "list":
21			return cmdProfilesList(args[1:])
22		case "help", "-h", "--help":
23			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Usage: %s profiles list [--dir <path>] [--json]\n", benchCommandName())
24			return 0
25		default:
26			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s profiles: unknown subcommand %q\n", benchCommandName(), args[0])
27			return 2
28		}
29	}
30	
31	func cmdProfilesList(args []string) int {
32		fs := flagSet("profiles list")
33		dir := fs.String("dir", "", "Profiles directory (default: scripts/benchmark/profiles relative to --work-dir)")
34		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Repository root (default: cwd)")
35		jsonOut := fs.Bool("json", false, "Emit JSON array instead of table")
36		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
37			return 2
38		}
39	
40		profilesDir := *dir
41		if profilesDir == "" {
42			profilesDir = filepath.Join(resolveWorkDir(*workDir), defaultProfilesDir)
43		}
44	
45		profiles, err := profile.LoadDir(profilesDir)
46		if err != nil {
47			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s profiles list: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
48			return 1
49		}
50	
51		if *jsonOut {
52			data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(profiles, "", "  ")
53			fmt.Println(string(data))
54			return 0
55		}
56	
57		if len(profiles) == 0 {
58			fmt.Printf("No profiles found in %s.\n", profilesDir)
59			return 0
60		}
61	
62		fmt.Printf("%-24s %-14s %-32s %-12s %-12s\n", "ID", "PROVIDER", "MODEL", "IN $/Mtok", "OUT $/Mtok")
63		fmt.Printf("%-24s %-14s %-32s %-12s %-12s\n", "--", "--------", "-----", "---------", "----------")
64		for _, p := range profiles {
65			fmt.Printf("%-24s %-14s %-32s %-12.4f %-12.4f\n",
66				p.ID,
67				string(p.Provider.Type),
68				p.Provider.Model,
69				p.Pricing.InputUSDPerMTok,
70				p.Pricing.OutputUSDPerMTok,
71			)
72		}
73		return 0
74	}
